title: Claw Ride
description: A ride combining deep underhook, head control, and hip pressure from turtle to expose the back or mat return.
topPlayerGoals: The top player wants to control Claw Ride through head position, inside position, and directed pressure.
Keep a deep underhook, head post, and offset hip pressure to prevent the stand-up.
Keep a stable base so you are not off-balanced or countered.
bottomPlayerGoals: The bottom player wants to survive Claw Ride with frames, pummeling, or the right angle.
Pummel the underhook out, bring the head to the hip line, and keep knees under hips.
Recognize danger signals early instead of waiting for the position to settle.
controlPoints: Main control point: Underhook depth, head post, and hip pressure vector..
Head, hands, hips, and knees should share the same force direction.
The elbow-knee connection or hip-shoulder line determines whether the position is still alive or already locked.
escapePriorities: Escape priority: Fight the underhook first — if the underhook is lost, head post and hip pressure are also neutralized..
Protect the neck, back, knee line, or arm line before countering.
If inside position is lost, reset one defensive layer first.

advancementOptions.action: Transition to hook or back take
advancementOptions.why: This is the natural branch when you win the main control point and the opponent is forced to defend.

dangerSignals: The chin or neck is pulled out of a safe line.
The elbow separates from the ribs or knee.
The hip line is locked while the shoulder line is still being pulled.
You need a long hand post to avoid falling.
